name: DirectDebitCollection
description: Represents a single BACS Direct Debit collection event — one execution of a payment against an active DirectDebitInstruction (ENT-034). Created by SVC-009 when the originator submits a collection instruction via BACS at D-2. Updated on D-0 processing (collected or returned) and on indemnity claim (indemnity_claimed). Part of the JRN-012 Direct Debit Setup and First Collection journey.

fields.name: collection_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated by SVC-009. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: ddi_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → DirectDebitInstruction.ddi_id (ENT-034). Must reference an active DDI. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places (GBP). For fixed DDIs must equal ENT-034.fixed_amount.

fields.name: collection_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). BACS debit date (D-0). Must be a valid BACS working day. Immutable.

fields.name: submission_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Date collection file received (D-2). Must be exactly 2 working days before collection_date. Immutable.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: submitted | collected | returned | indemnity_claimed. Transitions: submitted (D-2) → collected (D-0 success) or returned (D-0 failure); collected/returned → indemnity_claimed (DD Guarantee claim, PH-051).

fields.name: return_reason
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when status = returned. BACS ARUDD reason code. Null otherwise.

fields.name: bacs_transaction_reference
fields.validation_rule: Optional. BACS-assigned transaction reference from collection file. Used for scheme reconciliation.

fields.name: indemnity_claimed_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when status = indemnity_claimed. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when EVT-074 published.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable. Set at D-2 collection submission.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on any mutation.

relationships.description: DirectDebitCollection belongs to one DirectDebitInstruction. FK: ddi_id → DirectDebitInstruction.ddi_id.

design_decisions.decision: DirectDebitCollection is a separate entity from DirectDebitInstruction rather than a status on the instruction.
design_decisions.rationale: A single DDI may have many collections over its lifetime. Each collection has independent lifecycle states. Separate entity supports financial reconciliation and dispute history. Consistent with BACS scheme semantics.
